preamble: Devoicing of the alveolar implosive to [t]. Chong (Pearic) ta̤k 'trap' < Proto-Austroasiatic *ɗakʔ (Bahnar đăk) has t, and its breathy vowel continues a former voiced onset, as in Chong plṳː 'thigh' < Proto-Pearic *bluː. Khmer reached t in two attested steps: Proto-Austroasiatic *ɗaːkʔ 'water' > Old Khmer ទិក៑ dik > Modern Khmer ទឹក /tɨk/, filed under ɗ > d and d > t. Modern Khmer ɗ (ដ) is secondary, from earlier *t (ដៃ 'hand' < Proto-Mon-Khmer *t₁iiʔ).
phoneticEffects: Devoicing, Loss of Implosion, Airstream Change
